title: Never be afraid to ask questions
description: This analysis covers a large Microsoft Patch Tuesday release from November 2026 addressing 1,095 vulnerabilities, including 64 critical flaws with 48 allowing remote code execution. Notably, a Microsoft Office Outlook spoofing vulnerability (CVE-2026-124194) is actively exploited in the wild. Additionally, a zero-day use-after-free vulnerability in Google Chrome's XML component (CVE-2026-125350) is confirmed exploited in the wild. The advisory emphasizes prioritizing patching of actively exploited and critical remote code execution vulnerabilities in core services such as Exchange and Active Directory. Mitigations include applying patches and deploying new Snort rules to protect networks during patch rollout.
